<module id="right_shifter">
    <description>Right shifter module that shifts the input data to the right by one bit.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="d">Input signal to be shifted.</input>
        <output id="q">Output signal representing the shifted data.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Initialize q to 0. Right shift q by 1 bit on each rising edge of clk. Assign the value of d to the most significant bit of q.</implementation>
    <task id="shift_right">
        <description>Shifts the input data to the right by one bit.</description>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="d">Input signal to be shifted.</input>
        <output id="q">Output signal representing the shifted data.</output>
        <implementation>
            // Initialize q to 0
            initial begin
                q = 8'h0;
            end
            
            // Shift q to the right by 1 bit on each rising edge of clk
            always @(posedge clk) begin
                q <= (q >> 1);
            end
            
            // Assign the value of d to the most significant bit of q
            always @(posedge clk) begin
                q[7] <= d;
            end
        </implementation>
    </task>
</module>
